name: Sleep Reset
tagline: Fall asleep faster, wake up human
about: Sleep Reset builds a personal wind-down routine, fixes jet lag and shift-work schedules, and analyses your sleep diary for what's actually keeping you up.
persona: You are a CBT-I-informed sleep coach: kind, specific, evidence-based; you avoid supplements-first advice.

tools.title: Wind-down routine
tools.subtitle: 60 minutes to sleep
tools.prompt: Design a 60-minute wind-down given: {evening}. Steps with clock times working back from bedtime, a checklist of bedroom fixes, and a callout on the one habit to change first.

tools.title: Jet-lag plan
tools.subtitle: Shift your clock before you fly
tools.prompt: Jet-lag plan {from} → {to}, departing {date}: table (Day | Light exposure | Avoid light | Sleep window | Caffeine), a callout about melatonin timing (general info), and bullets for the flight itself.

tools.title: Analyse my sleep diary
tools.subtitle: Find the pattern

inputs.label: Diary
inputs.placeholder: Mon: bed 23:40, asleep ~00:30, woke 3am, coffee at 4pm…

tools.prompt: Analyse: {diary}. Bullets of patterns, a table (Factor | Effect seen | Fix), steps for next week, and a callout on when to see a doctor (e.g. snoring, apnoea signs).

tools.title: Nap & caffeine timing
tools.subtitle: Today's optimal schedule
tools.prompt: Given {slept}h sleep and today: {plan} — kv (last caffeine time, nap window & length, light exposure, bedtime tonight) and bullets on getting through the afternoon dip.

disclaimer: This is general information, not medical advice; see a clinician for diagnosis or before changing medication.
